decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1).The proposed development, due to its size, scale and appearance would represent an incongruous structure, over developing the site and resulting in an unattractive addition to the area, harmful to the appearance of the site, the street scene and  surrounding area. It would therefore constitute inappropriate development and be contrary to ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
2) The proposed units would not provide sufficient amenity space for the number of units proposed nor would the proposal, without any off street parking, meet the required parking standards. This is contrary to Policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and the Unitary Development Plan Supplementary Planning Guidance 1997.
